label: early original-phase step (t=3/4) of sequences starting with v, boosted by v/a/w/d/k/c prefix tokens
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase at t=3 (70% of mass) and t=4 (29%) of sequences whose first token is v (98% of mass; 28x lift). It never fires in the copy phase and almost never at the delimiter or at t<3 or t>=5. Within that window, magnitude depends on which tokens make up the prefix: it is strongest when orig(1..3) come from {v, a, w, d, k, c} (e.g. v v d a 1, v d d w 1). The current input token matters only a little (1 has the highest lift). The top examples all look like v v/d + a/w/d + digit 1. The positional-plus-first-token gate (first_tok=v, t in {3,4}) covers 96% of activations but has only 7% precision. Requiring prefix tokens from the set raises F1 to about 0.42 while keeping about 93% of mass. The response looks graded, like a weighted sum over prefix tokens rather than a clean boolean, so precision stays incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=v (+7.86), prev_tok=w (+4.81), prev_tok=a (+3.74), orig1=v (+3.65), prev2_tok=w (+3.34), prev2_tok=a (+3.03). Lower it: correct=1 (-8.19), orig_idx=-1 (-2.57), prev2_tok=h (-2.12), orig2=l (-2.05).
